label: Power Map substations and their 33 kV links
notes: The browser's copy is the CSV /api/power-map/data builds from the Supabase table (22 columns, rows with a Substation and both coordinates); on the VM the rows come from the table's JSON snapshot, the same 22 columns. Everything stays text: coordinates may be DMS (N25°00.026'), and Connected to / RL / ConductorSize / PeakLoad are colon-separated lists matched by position.
